assertions.name: quadratic_c_nonzero
assertions.source: |c| > 0.1 q₀-units in every triplet — a real bar-even quadratic beyond leading+linear (mirror pairs cannot see it)

assertions.name: mirror_diff_equals_2b
assertions.source: f(+1)−f(−1)=2b exactly (consistency with PR #3089 mirror method)

description: Isobaric-triplet (IMME) decomposition of the canonical residual log_q0 Δ_λ = a + b·T₃ + c·T₃². Mirror PAIRS (PR #3089) measure only the bar-odd b; the bar-even QUADRATIC c is invisible to them (it cancels in the mirror difference, Lean mirror_baseline_cancels) and needs a TRIPLET. A=6 (⁶He/⁶Li/⁶Be): a=36.12, b=−1.73 (consistent with the mirror b's −1.34@A3,−1.77@A7), c=−1.24 NONZERO. Askey: body-order b-ladder is continuous q-Hermite (3-term recurrence); IMME is the degree-2 T₃ truncation (Wigner rank-≤2 isotensor = Askey–Racah cutoff). CAVEAT: T₃=0 ground states are T=0 (not the T=1 analog), so c mixes the IMME quadratic with T=0/T=1 structure; robust claim = residual has a nonzero bar-even quadratic. Not wired; near-match; no fit.

data.imme_form: log_q0 Δ_λ(T₃) = a(A) + b(A)·T₃ + c(A)·T₃²,  T₃=(Z−N)/2

parity.b_linear: bar-ODD (T₃-odd) — the writhe Z-correction; mirror diff=2b·T₃
parity.c_quadratic: bar-EVEN (T₃-even) — cancels in mirror pairs; triplet 2nd diff=2c

askey.body_order_n: b-ladder a(n+2)=2cosh(10η)a(n+1)−a(n): continuous q-Hermite / Al-Salam–Chihara three-term recurrence (Askey q-scheme)
askey.isospin_T3: IMME degree-2 in T₃ = Wigner rank-≤2 isotensor truncation (Askey–Racah cutoff; no d·T₃³)

data.caveat_same_T: T₃=0 ground states (⁶Li,⁸Be) are T=0, not the T=1 isobaric analog; c mixes IMME-c with T=0/T=1 structure
